question: Which lineage-elevated son is prophesied to arise by name in that era?
premises: A son will come into being in that era.
That son will bear the name Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa.
That son will be elevated in lineage.
inference: A lineage-elevated son named Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa will arise.
plain_english: There would be a son named Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, elevated in lineage.
